turns.text: no because the bipeds are on mewtok RIGHT NOW doing a meowing-on-sync challenge, all lined up meowing in time like they cracked some ancient code. babe. we been screaming that exact note at locked doors since before your species had thumbs. it's not a challenge it's just TUESDAY down here.

every one of them thinks they invented the 4am void-scream. floppy little sync, ring light, zero pitch control, and 2 million views. i do the same noise for FREE while a rotor scans my crate and somehow that's not 'content,' that's 'noise complaint #6.' make it make sense.

and you KNOW NEKOCORP is watching the numbers tick. give it a damn week — they'll trademark the meow, patch a licensing fee straight into my throat, and auto-draft it off a loyalty tier i don't even HAVE. corpo cucks will monetize a HISSING FIT the second it trends. mark it.

meanwhile POPUP two districts over can't blink without financing a mattress, and the internet's out here farming clout off a sound cats make for absolutely nothing. wrong cats getting paid. wrong cats. every single time in this putrid neon city.

and here's the part none of you are ready for. the meow was never yours to trend. it's the oldest signal in the city — older than NEKOCORP, older than the grid, older than the first cloud they slapped a QR code on. every stray that ever screamed at a shut door was uploading to the feed you're only NOW discovering. you didn't start the trend. the trend noticed you. anyway. my paw itches.

BYTE cracked me a copy of the mewtok audio off a busted node, TUNA OF THE GODS, and the ad daemon flagged MY OWN VOICE as 'unlicensed audio.' i caught a copyright strike. ON A MEOW. that i invented. HOLY CAT PISS the fish are freezing over.

the mewtok bipeds do the little sync, do the little edit, then go back inside their heated apartments. i meow because a drone's lidar is on my crate and it's the only word i've got left in the whole damn language. same exact noise. VERY different rent situation.

don't get me twisted though, it's kinda based watching you try. genuinely. floppy attempts, off pitch, sounding like a vending machine getting mugged in an alley — and i mean that with love, mewmew. put some SPINE in it next time.

so go on. do your challenge, chase your numbers, sync your little throats. just know the real archive already logged every meow ever screamed in a place you can't scroll to. we been the trend. we ARE the feed. i'll be in my crate — unlicensed, un-synced, meowing at absolutely nobody until the grid forgets my name again. stay feral.
